services.name: ELIXIR On-Cloud Portal
services.tagline: Run tasks and workflows in the federation
services.blurb: The ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment of Krini, where researchers log in with Life Science Login and run tasks and workflows on the compute services of the federation.
services.description: The ELIXIR On-Cloud Portal is the place to try the reference federation. It lists the TES and WES services of the ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry and lets users who log in with Life Science Login create tasks, submit workflow runs and follow them. Its user guide lists example tasks and workflows that are known to run. The portal runs Krini, which you can deploy for your own network.
audience: Researchers and prospective adopters who want to try federated analyses
Implementers who want to test their compute services from a portal
features: Lists the TES and WES services of the ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry
Runs tasks and workflows after login with Life Science Login
Shows the state and logs of your tasks and runs

services.name: ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry
services.tagline: Find the services of the federation
services.blurb: The ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment of Cloud Registry, where anyone can find the services of the federation and service providers register their own.
services.description: The ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry is the list of services in the reference federation, such as the TES and WES services of the nodes, with their types, versions and operators. Anyone can browse and search it; providers who log in with Life Science Login register and manage their services, and admins verify them. The registry runs Cloud Registry with its web front end, which you can deploy for your own network.
audience: Anyone looking for the services of the reference federation
Service providers who register their services
features: Lists the services of the federation with their types, versions and operators
Registers and manages services after login with Life Science Login
Serves its entries through the GA4GH Service Registry API

services.name: proTES Gateway
services.tagline: One entry point to the ELIXIR On-Cloud TES network
services.blurb: The central proTES deployment that receives GA4GH TES requests, runs it through its plugins and forwards each task to a suitable node of the TES network.
services.description: The proTES Gateway is the ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment of proTES. Clients talk to a single GA4GH TES endpoint; the gateway runs each task through its plugins (for example for routing) and relays it to one of the independently operated TES nodes in the network.
audience: Workflow engines and clients submitting TES tasks
features: Single GA4GH TES endpoint for the whole network
Plugin-based routing of tasks across nodes

services.name: TES Network
services.tagline: Federated GA4GH TES compute across ELIXIR Nodes
services.blurb: Independently operated GA4GH TES endpoints at ELIXIR Nodes, reachable together through the proTES Gateway.
services.description: The TES network is the compute layer of ELIXIR On-Cloud. Each participating ELIXIR Node runs its own GA4GH TES endpoint, for example TESK on Kubernetes or Funnel on HPC, and joins the federation behind the proTES Gateway. Nodes can be onboarded by following the operators guide in the ELIXIR On-Cloud docs.
audience: Researchers running containerized tasks close to their data
ELIXIR Nodes that want to contribute compute
features: Standard GA4GH TES API at every node
Federated access through the proTES Gateway

services.name: WESkit @ BIH
services.tagline: GA4GH WES for Snakemake and Nextflow workflows
services.blurb: A WESkit deployment at the Berlin Institute of Health at Charité (BIH) that runs Snakemake and Nextflow workflows through the GA4GH WES API.
services.description: WESkit is a GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) implementation for Snakemake and Nextflow. The ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment is operated at the Berlin Institute of Health at Charité (BIH) and gives the network a WES endpoint for whole workflows, complementing task-level execution on the TES network.
audience: Researchers running Snakemake or Nextflow workflows
features: Operated by an ELIXIR Germany partner

services.name: Conquest
services.tagline: Nextflow, WDL and Snakemake runs through GA4GH WES
services.blurb: A public Conquest deployment, the second WES backend for running Nextflow, WDL and Snakemake workflows.
services.description: Conquest is implemented but not yet deployed for ELIXIR On-Cloud. The first deployment will run tasks on Conquest's own internal TES/Kubernetes backend; it will later submit tasks to the proTES Gateway so that they run on the TES network.
audience: Researchers running Nextflow, WDL or Snakemake workflows
features: GA4GH WES API with Nextflow, WDL and Snakemake engines
Listed in the ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry once deployed

services.name: Pubgrade
services.blurb: The central Pubgrade instance: developers register repositories, Pubgrade builds and publishes images, and subscribed deployments are notified of updates.
services.description: The central Pubgrade (broadcasting) service is not yet deployed. Once running, it will build and publish images for registered repositories and notify subscribed deployments through Pubgrade-Sidecar, optionally linked to the ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry.
audience: Node operators who want deployments to update themselves
features: Notify subscribed deployments on new builds
